decision.explanation: The sources explicitly support three distinct occupational roles for Michel Gardes. D1S4 and D1S8 identify him as a 'French politician' (past and general role). D2S12 states he 'started his career as an apprentice electrician' (past occupation). D2S3 describes him as a 'seasoned politician' (current/general role in the narrative context). All three answers are directly supported by the text and represent valid, non-contradictory aspects of his biography (career progression and descriptive titles).
